title: Passenger Quad-Rotor VTOL
description: A personal-mobility VTOL concept built around four large rotors and a protected central cabin. The direct-lift layout favors mechanical clarity and hover authority while making occupant packaging, landing clearance, and rotor separation primary design drivers.
